_meta.purpose: Deterministic cost/price layer for the financial engine (§C.9). Each line carries {value, source, assumption} so the trace can render provenance.
_meta.status: Fertilizer prices, labor wage, land prep, and farmgate price verified via web search against real recent sources (2026-07-24). Per-operation labor splits, gypsum, seed price, and irrigation still `_verify: true` — no precise per-line source found this pass.

fertilizer_prices_bdt_per_kg._source: GoB farmer-level subsidized prices, 2023 hike (confirmed still current as of this pass) — New Age BD 'Bangladesh government raises fertiliser prices by Tk 5 per kg'; BSS News.

gypsum._note: no current per-kg gypsum retail price found via search this pass

man_day_bdt.source: BBS agricultural wage data, male worker, Jul-Sep 2025 (FY2025-26 Q1) — via Bonikbarta 'Agri wages fall...'
man_day_bdt.assumption: average of Jul (621) / Aug (616) / Sep (608) 2025 BBS figures

land_prep_tillage.source: power-tiller, two-pass tillage, T. Aman non-saline-area cost study (ResearchGate 'Per Hectare Cost and Return of T. Aman Rice in Non Saline Area', Tk 4,990/ha)

transplanting_labor._note: total T. Aman labor (transplant+weed+harvest) benchmarks at ~70 man-days/ha (30 family + 40 hired) per the same non-saline-area study, but no per-operation split was found — this line is still an unverified estimate

aman_rice._note: 40 kg/ha is BRRI's standard T. Aman transplanted-HYV seed rate; per-kg price not independently verified this pass

boro_rice._note: Same BRRI standard transplanted-HYV seed rate/price as aman_rice — not independently re-verified for Boro specifically this pass.

aus_rice._note: Same BRRI standard transplanted-HYV seed rate/price as aman_rice — not independently re-verified for Aus specifically this pass.

potato._note: Seed rate is a standard BARI-recommended range midpoint (2000-2500 kg/ha), not independently re-verified this pass. Price is the GoB-recommended minimum seed-potato price from the prior season (Tk 57/kg) — 2025's actual market price collapsed to Tk 15-16/kg due to oversupply (freshplaza.com 'Bangladesh farmers face soaring seed costs, threatening potato crop viability'), so the prior-year recommended minimum is used here as a more representative normal-year figure than the crash price.

irrigation._note: Aman is largely rainfed; supplemental only. Boro irrigation would be ~20–25% of cost (§1.6 [DOC]).

aman_rice.source: GoB Aman 2025-season paddy procurement price (raised from Tk 33) — The Business Standard 'Govt to procure 7 lakh tonnes of Aman paddy, rice from local sources at higher prices from 20 Nov'
aman_rice.assumption: government procurement price used as the practical farmgate-price proxy

boro_rice.source: GoB Boro 2025-26 season paddy procurement price — Bangladesh Pratidin 'Govt sets procurement prices for Boro season paddy, rice and wheat' (2026-04-22); jagonews24 'Govt to procure Boro paddy at Tk 36, rice at Tk 49 per kg'.
boro_rice.assumption: government procurement price used as the practical farmgate-price proxy, same convention as aman_rice.

aus_rice.source: No dedicated GoB Aus procurement price found via search. Using the GoB Aman 2025-season procurement price (Tk 34/kg, cited above for aman_rice) as the nearest seasonal proxy.
aus_rice.assumption: government procurement price used as the practical farmgate-price proxy — borrowed from Aman's rate since Aus has no distinct published GoB procurement price this pass.

potato.source: DAE-reported farmgate price, Feb 2025 (Tk 11-15/kg) — The Daily Star 'Potato farmers in peril as prices fall below production costs'.
potato.assumption: Upper end of the DAE-reported Feb 2025 farmgate range used.
potato._note: This reflects a 2025 oversupply/price-collapse period; a normal-year farmgate price could run higher.
